WITH college_player_counts AS (
    SELECT c.college_id, c.state, COUNT(pc.player_id) AS player_count
    FROM college AS c
    JOIN player_college AS pc ON pc.college_id = c.college_id
    GROUP BY c.college_id, c.state
), college_metrics AS (
    SELECT state, player_count,
           player_count * 1.0 / AVG(player_count) OVER () AS relative_to_average,
           player_count * 1.0 / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
    FROM college_player_counts
)
SELECT state,
       AVG(player_count) AS avg_college_player_count,
       AVG(relative_to_average) AS avg_relative_to_overall_average,
       AVG(share_of_total) AS avg_share_of_total
FROM college_metrics
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY state;
